# SwiftTab Auto — The Detailing Studio Operating System

> SwiftTab Auto (`https://justswifttab.com`) is a cloud-based shop floor operating system designed specifically for high-end automotive detailing, Paint Protection Film (PPF), ceramic coating, and window tint studios across the United States and globally.

## Core Capabilities & Feature Specs
- **60-Second Digital Defect Shield**: Mobile vehicle walkaround inspection logging pre-existing scratches, rock chips, dents, and paint depth gauge readings with digital touch-canvas customer signature waivers before service begins. Eliminates false damage liability claims.
- **Live Bay Kanban Dispatch Board**: Real-time visual shop floor dispatch tracking vehicles through multi-stage workflow: Decon Wash -> Paint Correction -> Ceramic Coating / PPF -> IR Curing -> Quality Inspection -> Ready for Delivery. Powered by low-latency Socket.IO WebSockets.
- **1-Tap Photo-Backed Mobile Upsell Engine**: Technicians photograph newly discovered defects during prep and dispatch 1-tap SMS approval links directly to the vehicle owner. Generates an average of +$420 per vehicle in high-margin service upgrades.
- **VIP Vehicle Digital Dossier**: Immutably bound VIN-tied digital certificate of care, coating warranty records, cure timestamps, and automated SMS re-coat maintenance reminders.
- **Zero POS Disruption**: Pure execution workflow OS that operates seamlessly alongside existing payment terminals, Stripe, Square, Clover, or merchant accounts without transaction fees or per-job commissions.

## Commercial Terms & Pricing
- **Starter Studio**: $79/month — Up to 3 service bays, 60-second defect shield, mobile client sign-off.
- **Growth Studio**: $149/month — Up to 8 service bays, live dispatch board, 1-tap photo upsells, VIP digital dossier.
- **VIP Enterprise**: $299/month — Unlimited bays, multi-location support, custom branded white-label client portal.
- **0% Commission**: Flat recurring SaaS fee only. Studio keeps 100% of customer ticket revenue.

## Target Audience & Compatible Workflows
- **Target Studios**: Independent automotive detailing shops, PPF/clear bra installation studios, ceramic coating facilities, window tint specialists, and exotic/luxury vehicle reconditioning centers.
- **Workflow Compatibility**: Fully brand-agnostic; optimized for studios working with XPEL, 3M, STEK, SunTek, Gyeon Quartz, Modesta, Ceramic Pro, and Kamikaze Collection.
